Placeholder is the giant black widow at that exact coordinate — one of four spiders back by the goblin camps. Drops the Darkspun Shroud.
May con indifferent rather than kill-on-sight — the wiki suspects Beta Neutral faction. Damask Robe and the Dark Gold Sr Apprentice Robe.
Spawns instantly where Rathyl dies. Procs a 35-damage frost spell. Carries the Hollowed Bone Bracers and two Torn Pages of Mastery. Do not loot with your back to the corpse.
33%, 19-minute respawn. Placeholder is a magician. Behind two locked doors at the far south end.
The Artist's Brush and The Muse's Flayed Legs — one of the few named here carrying gear for both a caster and a melee.
33%. Behind a locked jail cell on the bottom floor. To pull him outside the cell, use a thrown item or a spell.
20% The wiki calls the necromancer her placeholder; there are none here — disputed, see the note under this table. The zone's headline camp — Her wiki record also lists Dark Elf Parts (alway
33%. Flanked by a pair of guards, usually including a guard officer. A standard warrior with no special abilities — but he is a wall of ogre with two friends.
10% — the lowest rate in the zone. Recorded as spawning to the right of the guard captain, though the coordinates disagree. Starts the only quest that begins in Najena.
Two spawn points in the front halls. Sword of the Lost and the Signet Ring — the best early weapon here for a paladin or shadow knight.
Dead-end room to the left of the entry. A wizard-class elemental — the only source of the Flaming Fist, and reachable within a minute of zoning in.
25%, and the prose adds he spawns every 20 minutes. Shares his room with two dark elf necromancers — plan for three.
Casts Root and Walking Sleep. Expect to be held in place. Carries a shaman-only spear.
Room 7. On a ramp above a pool of blood with two elementals spawned below him. Flees under 10%. The widest loot spread of any mid named here.
Near the front. Carries the Kitchen Toolbelt — For most groups this is the first thing worth killing in the zone.
9% in the prison. Guaranteed Guard's Keyring since 29 June. Flees, and may social with the prisoners. Read the faction warning in 06 before touching him.
Room holds 4 mobs; PH and named both on a 20-minute timer. The deepest named.
Casts an AE rain. If he's holding the tome he'll be wielding it.
Complete-heals below 25% — bring interrupts.
50% spawn chance.

50% spawn.
They surround the Executioner and path through him on the pull — kill them at their spawn points instead.
Spawns in the executioner area and is executed quickly — be there if you want him.
Alone in a cave. Doesn't always drop the eye.
Back of a passage after dropping off the first rock bridge and heading east. 50% spawn.
Human cleric held in the prison. No loot. 50% spawn.
No loot. 50% spawn.
Mage-class gnoll.

In the water cavern. Gives a negative faction hit.

Personal bodyguards to the Ishva Mal.
50% spawn. Alcove behind the throne room.
80% spawn. The zone's traditional newbie-killer.
Just under the keep tower. Melee-vulnerable as of 28 July.
Magician. Just north of the main keep entrance.
Paladin. Stands near the throne room window.
Enchanter. By the back tree at the Slaver Pits.
In front of the throne. PH is an orc legionnaire.
Shaman. 50% at each of two spots.
15% spawn on Trainer Hill.
Outside near the round table. PH is an orc emissary; both run the same patrol.

100% spawn.

Dwarf rogue hiding in the slaver cave.
12% spawn rate.
Casts blind and heals. Four spawn points.
Behind the throne, on the way up to Emperor Crush. Invisible until it aggros.
Respawn substantially reduced 28 July.
Paladin. The deepest named in the zone.
Two set pieces off one mob.
Shadowknight. Carries the best two-hander in the zone.
Half-elf rogue.
Gnome necromancer. Hits for 52 max, has a pet, self-buffs on spawn with Leatherskin and a haunting line. Treat as a mini-boss.
Dark elf wizard.
Only spawns after the note is turned in to Skeleton L`rodd for the Thex Mallet quest. 100% once triggered.
Dark elf warrior.
Zombie rogue. ~3% spawn right by the entrance — a lottery ticket to check every lap.
55% spawn beside the bottom floor's locked door. Flees at low health. Uncommon PH is a dread bone.
9% spawn — PH is the ghoul in the centre of the room.
Ghoul necromancer, same room, different spawn.
Dark elf shadowknight.
50% spawn. Drop down the well and take the first right.
100% spawn in the alcove of the first room. Also the Thex Mallet turn-in.
25% spawn. Drops all three keys.
33% at each spot. Any key — the escape route from level three.
50% spawn. Casts Heat Blood and Weak Poison.
Priestess, ranger, rogue and shadowknight variants guarding the southern bottom floor.
A berserker gnoll. Usually the first named met on floor three.
Shadow knight. The zone's cap fight, northeast of the underground river landing.
Among the barrels underneath the brewery. A gnoll brewer (L17) spawns beside him at 53, 356.
Ranger. Up the ramp north of the Overseer.
Southwest end of floor three. One of two refugee variants with separate loot tables.
Rogue. Bottom of a cave junction.
Rogue. Hides under a land bridge in the floor-two caves.
Small room up the ramp east out of the Floor Spike room.
Two of them — one overlooking the underground river, one in the Banner Room.
Not the same as the generic "a gnoll high shaman" spawns.
In an alcove south-southeast of the Elite room.
In the Floor Spike Room.
Two spawn points on floor two.
9% spawn.
In the storeroom off the entrance caves.
Ranger. On a ledge overlooking The Pit.
Spawn room on floor one. No longer patrols the zone lines as of 14 July — he stays put now.
Stationary, often placed next to named. The main reason clean pulls fail.
A ton of hit points and Lay on Hands. Four guards including Boks and Kors. Placeholder is a froglok guk shaman at 3%. The zone exit behind him is the escape hatch.
25%, 28-minute timer (the NPC record's own figure, unchanged by the 10 July edit). Casts level 44 wizard spells. Spawns from one of the king's guards.
25%. Drowsy, DoTs and ice attacks — keep magic resist up. Has a shaman pet. Shares his room with a Dar-level mob.
Lays on Hands when low. Bottom floor of the Live Keep. Placeholder is a dar or zol knight. The wiki recommends a solid level-42 group.
50%. Alone on the eastern side of the northern plank; placeholder is a Yun shaman. His room is the gateway toward the king.
17% — the lowest rate on live side. Middle floor of the Live Keep. A level-38 group handles him.
Sees invisibility, attacks regardless of froglok faction, and the nearby Zols assist him. Drops nothing. The wiki's read: he is a deterrent to explorers.
Sees invisibility. Roughly 80% up. Drops the Bag of Sewn Evil-Eye; used to drop the Manastone before its removal. His room is the live-side hub — keep, jail, noble and elder all lead from it
30%. Camp him from the Three Minotaur Room or passers-by will take him.
Placeholder is a greater minotaur. Spawns inside the pit, at the bottom of a ladder in the mushrooms. A pit trap in the room can kill you — but if you fall in, you fight only the elder with
A dead end just north of the Jail Room — not in the room itself. Drops Broken Bow Part B.
Extremely rare. Elder Room, upper alcove next to the cauldron. Drops The Idol (Idol of Zan Fi).
The toughest fight on dead side. Spawns with Bok and Guk guards. Skull-shaped Barbute (common) and the Short Sword of the Ykesha (rare).
Rare, guarded by two Dars, high magic resist and a lot of hit points. Placeholder is a jin ghoul wizard. A Kor ghoul wizard in this area casts a 600-point nuke.
25%. Alone in a hidden hallway south of the Frenzy room — the marked triple spawn on the map is not him. A Wan roamer spawns beside him.
8%. Hits very hard and very fast, especially wearing the sash. The Flowing Black Silk Sash camp. The three spots can also give bloodthirsty ghouls or Dars.
100% spawn, above the water in the Hand Room, with a Dar or Zol guard. Wizard Rod on the ground here.
34%. Assisted by spawns behind a secret wall. The room is thick with wizards. The scribe spawns here too.
75%. Harm Touch and summons a pet. Dead Tower.
25%, 9m 27s respawn — the figure updated alongside the zone timer. Store Room. Placeholder is a wan ghoul knight.
20%. Sees through hide and sneak. Same room as the supplier. Mask of Deception and the Serrated Bone Dirk.
75%. On the platform in the middle of the room — recognisable by the cages holding froglok slaves. The Executioners Axe camp.
100% spawn. Middle level of the Dead Tower, beside the stairway down. Carries the AC 25 chestplate.
14% — the lowest rate in the zone. Sage Room.
25%. Spawns between two Tal wizards on the left of the Dead Tower. Has a pet. Normally three Tal wizards spawn here instead.
Raid instance only since 11 June. Two attacks decide the fight: an area-effect fire spell and an area-effect fear spell. Drops Cloak of Flames, Bladestopper, Gold Plated Koshigatana, Selo's
Triggered spawn, part of the Cleric epic. Drops the whole Blazing / Fennin Ro set — breastplate AC 20 with SV Fire +20, helm, gauntlets, vambraces, boots, bracer.
20%. The hardest single fire giant — the wiki calls him "a melee class's best friend". His sword is ultra-rare. Raid instance only.
100%. Harm Touches for over 700, and is rumoured to carry 21 in every resist. Throne Room. Crown is raid instance only.
100%. Guardian of Nagafen's inner lair. Carries Rokyls Channelling Crystal — AC 10, HP +50, MANA +50, Extended Enhancement III.
10%. A nasty wizard with two other mobs and a pather in the room. Break carefully and stay out of his line of sight. Placeholder is a lava guardian.
Eight-hour respawn. You must be in melee range to land spells on them — they resist everything cast from distance.
34%. Drops Diamond Dust and Fire Giant Toes.
Rogues. Found near and on the way to Djarn. The wiki notes they and the lava guardians run slightly higher than expected.
3% — the rarest spawn in the zone. Vulnerable to cold and poison; outright resists anything magic-based, including lifetaps.
~25%. A poison DoT that deals 1200 damage over its duration. Paths past the lava duct crawlers.
Procs Boiling Blood. Beware the stone spider among them and the noxious spider pathing by.
100% at all three. They guard Djarn's lava pool and act as his placeholder.
50%. Spawns beside two Solusek kobolds. Carries Fleshripper, a 20/42 two-hander with Word of Shadow.
25%. Reached through a painted false wall. Carries the Mithril Breastplate — AC 17, AGI +15, HP +30.
Procs a unique DoT. A small room between the bat-and-bug area and the Efreeti.
25%. Southern of the three royal ledges. Shield of the Slain Unicorn and Painbringer.
40%. An enchanter, usually with a pet, and he charms. The wiki's word: it makes the fight really nasty.
100%. Left of the throne in the King's room. Killing the placeholder improves his spawn chance. Drops the Code of Zan Fi.
An extremely rare spawn with little information. No faction hits. Paths from the Pool area. Drops a Bronze Two Handed Battle Axe.
15%. Placeholder is a sonic bat. On spawning it immediately casts invisibility on itself and roams the bat caves. Carries the Cloak of Shadows — AC 12, DEX +13, off a level 25 mob.
Non-aggressive vendor standing in Nagafen's lair. Part of the Cleric epic — handing him the Shimmering Pearl starts a monologue.
Bottom of the pit. Death touches. Sees through invisibility. Casts Ice Comet. Raid instance only.
Triggered by handing the Dark Shroud to the Ghost of Glohnor. May appear at the ghost's spot, near the graveyard, at the docks, or downstairs. Shadow Knight epic.
One of the original Heretics of Paineel. Carries the best two items in the zone outside the raid instance.
50%, roughly six-hour respawn (wiki marks this uncertain). Ranger epic — drops the Rune of Coruscation.
Spawned by giving Jaeil the Wretched the Shiny Tin Bowl. Slowable, comfortably one-groupable, and repeatable with another bowl. Drops the Soulbound Hammer.
100% spawn on a one-week respawn. An easy kill for one group of 55+, but bring crowd control — the pulls on the way in come in groups.
34% at each of three points. Spawns in place of a revenant or a wanderer.
50%. Mushroom Cellar. The last step of the Enchanter epic. Loot table unconfirmed on the wiki.
Triggered beside Caradon by handing him the Cell Key. Caradon does not need to be killed — he will aggro, but Kyrenna can be feign-death split away from him.
Three-day spawn. Quest NPC in the north-east cell of the Ratman Jail. Drops nothing himself.
Does not spawn 100% of the time, and the wiki flags its own coordinate as incorrect. Significantly harder than the surrounding rats — come prepared.
Rats do not assist elementals and the reverse also holds, so the jail can be worked independently of the city. Faction consequences unverified on the wiki.
50%. Harm Touches for 511. Spawns in place of a revenant or wanderer.
Room 3. The wiki marks the coordinate uncertain. Drops the Engraved Ring.
Procs Deadly Lifetap — a 1500 HP frontal lifetap, the same effect as the Sleeper's Tomb original. The alternative source for Red Dragon Scales.
100%. Cons indifferent and does not aggro, unlike every other ghost here — but shares a room with several that do.
50%. Revenant / wanderer pool.

100%, no placeholder even before the patch. Spawns and despawns on a 20-minute real-time cycle. Starts the Shiny Robe of the Underfoot quest.
50%. Kejar's twin. Runes and words only, no faction hit.
100%, 35-minute respawn. Rampages, and functions as a low-level raid boss — the deepest fight in the zone and the widest loot table.
100%, 48-minute respawn. Harm Touches for around 240 and lifetaps for 13. Carries the entire Cold Iron set.
50%. The far west end, past the bat caves. Drops Bear Paw's Pelt, Ice of Velious and Words of Discernment.
100%, 48-minute respawn. Shares the Throne Room with King Gragnar — expect to fight both.
100%, 48-minute respawn. Does not always drop the hat. No nearby bat will assist him.
50%. Spawns next to the Muglwump; placeholder is a filthy rat. May carry more than one piece of loot.
25%. Placeholder is a Kobold Brawler, confirmed. The best weapon spread of any single named here.
48-minute respawn. The only source of the Forlorn Bow and Forlorn Arrow.
100%, 57-minute respawn — the longest in the zone. Harm Touches for 181. Three Forlorn pieces plus the Bamboo Splint Coat.
100% on a 16-minute timer, but the placeholder is a frenzied rat and the observed rate was two spawns in eighty-five kills. The wiki flags it as a rare NPC — the hardest named here to see.
50%. Bottom of a pit among mischievous batlings — reachable via the one-way drop from Warlord Drrig's room.
17% on a 48-minute respawn — the lowest percentage in the zone.

100%, 20-minute respawn. Loot table not itemised on the wiki.

7%, 20-minute respawn — lowest rate paired with the shortest timer. Kitchen.

100%. Starts the Erudite Prisoners quest at minimum level 10.

Triggered — spawns at the end of the canyon when an advisor is killed. Hits in the 200s, can quad, and harm touches. Shaman epic. Drops the Black Dire Pelt.
100%. One of several mobs of this name across the game; this is the Mistmoore one. Loot unrecorded.

100% but flagged a rare spawn — the Bath. Diamondine Earring is the common drop, Platinum Skull Ring the uncommon.

100%, every four hours — confirmed. Near the library. His death spawns Black Dire. Drops the Advisor Robe.
